quote.text: No man can have a peaceful life who thinks too much about lengthening it, or believes that living through many consulships is a great blessing. 5. Rehearse this thought every day, that you may be able to depart from life contentedly; for many men clutch and cling to life, even as those who are carried down a rushing stream clutch and cling to briars and sharp rocks.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that obsessing over longevity can rob you of the present; cherish the precious moments with your children without clinging too tightly to an idealized future.
    • Embrace the fleeting nature of life by teaching your offspring to live with purpose and authenticity, accepting change as a natural part of growing up.
  • Leadership
    • A wise leader understands that fixating on everlasting accomplishments distracts you from the true measure of leadership—making impactful decisions in the moment.
    • Lead by example in accepting life’s inevitable changes; remind yourself and your team that true contentment lies in purposeful action rather than in simply extending one’s tenure or influence.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, focusing solely on longevity of a product or an endless stream of improvements can hinder innovative leaps; sometimes, decisive iteration leads to greater breakthroughs.
    • Balance long-term planning with agile responsiveness, as clinging to outdated metrics or prolonged cycles can stifle creativity and the ability to truly satisfy user needs.
